text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary probes failing from apac-east-2: > 30% consecutive failures across 6 probes. probe-group: synth-canary-apac-2, run_id: 2026-03-15T02:33Z, severity: paged
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered incident ID PD-98765 — urgent -> page sent to on-call
sam: acked via PD. I'm on it, switching to diagnostic mode.
aisha: oncall here. thx sam — are we seeing 5xx or timeouts? any client-facing impact yet?
sam: mostly TLS handshake timeouts and a few 503s. latency spikes in the probe logs. no customer tickets yet but recent deploy in apac region completed ~20m ago.
lee: tagging infra — looks like a small mem pressure pattern on the apac inference pool in metrics. http://grafana/redwood/d/apac-infer?panel=13 (short window shows GC spikes) :warning:
natalie: putting canaries into read-only / reroute mode so we don't flood the pool. run: `rbctl synth disable --group synth-canary-apac-2 --reason "investigating"`
sam: running that now. output: ```
> disabling synth group synth-canary-apac-2
> ok: 8 probes disabled
> queued reroute to fallback pool: apac-standby
```
aisha: good, please confirm fallback pool health before full reroute.
ops-bot: healthcheck: apac-standby OK (3/3 nodes healthy), avg latency 42ms, free GPU mem 76%
sam: rerouting probes to apac-standby: `rbctl synth reroute --from synth-canary-apac-2 --to synth-canary-apac-standby` -> accepted
incident-bot: [UPDATE] PagerDuty incident PD-98765 acknowledged by sam. Escalation paused.
lee: allocating extra buffer on the primary inference pool to clear GC churn: `infractl mem-tune apac-primary --heap-headroom=20%` — applying now.
natalie: quick postmortem note: recent model shard hotreload at 02:12 may have triggered cache churn. pulling logs.
aisha: assigning customer-impact assessment: low for now, we'll keep comms team on standby. if probe failures continue >15min we trigger status page.
sam: logs snippet: ```
[02:30:12] tls_handshake_timeout peer=10.4.2.11
[02:30:14] 503 service_unavailable model-serving/worker-7
[02:30:18] kvcache-miss surge=0.78
```
lee: looked at kernel OOMs? none. looks memory fragmentation + a background shard reload is the likely culprit.
natalie: I'll rollback the shard reload if error rate doesn't drop after the reroute + mem-tune in 5m. prepping rollback command: `modelctl rollback --shard reload-20260315-0212`
ops-bot: reminder: oncall rotation @aisha ends in 40m. please coordinate handoff if unresolved.
aisha: noted — if PD still active at +30m I'll hand off to lee (next oncall).
sam: current status: probes disabled on original group, rerouted to standby, initial error rate down to 4% from 33%. continuing to monitor.
incident-bot: [RESOLVE] PagerDuty PD-98765: paging suspended; monitoring-only. will reopen if failures exceed threshold within 15m. :white_check_mark:
aisha: thanks team. adding runbook notes and will create an incident ticket for follow-up (root cause: shard hotreload induced cache churn).
natalie: creating the ticket now and adding logs + timeline. ticket: INC-2026-2345
lee: follow-up actions: add graceful drain on shard reloads, increase mem headroom in apac primary, and add synthetic variance test post-deploy.
aisha: closing thread for now, keep watches on. :lock:
